findings.title: Repeated publication does not verify retained artifact availability
findings.scenario: After valid static publication, a missing served files/index.html leaves the catalog intact. New recoverAccepted invokes publish(record,true), but static-publication.mjs:93 returns cached URLs before byte verification. Actual publishAcceptedRevision returns published:true while its artifact route returns503. Recovery can publish an unavailable application link and finish accounting.
findings.repair: Verify retained source/artifact files against exact accepted binding before returning recovered publication; fail closed on missing or changed bytes. Reuse existing verification and add focused existing-test regression. Keep mirror and terminal fences.
